bugs.title: Checkout returns 500 when the cart does not exist
bugs.failingTest: returns 404 when the cart does not exist
bugs.description: CheckoutService.checkout() dereferences cart.items before confirming the cart was found, so an unknown cartId throws a TypeError and the API returns HTTP 500 instead of a clean 404.

bugs.title: Checkout response omits formattedTotal (misspelled property)
bugs.description: The checkout response ships the key as 'formatedTotal' instead of 'formattedTotal', so every API consumer reads undefined for the human-readable total.

bugs.title: Pricing imports the legacy 5% tax module, undercharging VAT
bugs.failingTest: applies 20% VAT to the taxable total
bugs.description: PricingService imports calcTax from './tax.legacy' (the retired 5% rate) instead of './tax' (current 20% VAT), so every order is taxed at the wrong rate.

bugs.title: Checkout accepts an empty customer name (no input validation)
bugs.failingTest: rejects checkout with an empty customer name (400)
bugs.description: The global ValidationPipe (APP_PIPE) was removed from AppModule, so malformed payloads such as an empty customer name are accepted and produce a confirmed order instead of a 400.

bugs.title: Declined payment crashes checkout with a 500
bugs.failingTest: returns 400 when the payment is declined
bugs.description: The call to PaymentGateway.charge() is not wrapped in try/catch, so a declined card throws and the API returns HTTP 500 instead of a clean 400 with a payment-failed message.
